import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_completed_square_range
    (a c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, (∃ x : ℝ, f x = y) ↔ c ≤ y := by
  intro y
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h₁ : f x = y := hx
    have h₂ : f x = (x - a)^2 + c := by rw [hf]
    rw [h₂] at h₁
    have h₃ : (x - a)^2 + c = y := by linarith
    have h₄ : (x - a)^2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
    linarith
  · 
    intro h
    
    use a + Real.sqrt (y - c)
    have h₁ : f (a + Real.sqrt (y - c)) = y := by
      have h₂ : f (a + Real.sqrt (y - c)) = (a + Real.sqrt (y - c) - a)^2 + c := by
        rw [hf]
      rw [h₂]
      have h₃ : (a + Real.sqrt (y - c) - a)^2 + c = (Real.sqrt (y - c))^2 + c := by
        ring
      rw [h₃]
      have h₄ : (Real.sqrt (y - c))^2 = y - c := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ y - c by linarith)]
      rw [h₄]
      <;> linarith
    exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_completed_square_range
    (a c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    ∀ y : ℝ, (∃ x : ℝ, f x = y) ↔ c ≤ y := by
  intro y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [hf x] at hx
    linarith [sq_nonneg (x - a)]
  · intro hy
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ y - c := sub_nonneg.mpr hy
    refine ⟨a + Real.sqrt (y - c), ?_⟩
    calc
      f (a + Real.sqrt (y - c)) =
          (a + Real.sqrt (y - c) - a)^2 + c := hf _
      _ = (Real.sqrt (y - c))^2 + c := by ring
      _ = y := by
        rw [Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg]
        linarith
